environment: local native macOS driver and native Linux verification backend on Docker Desktop; not production topology
measurementBoundary: System.nanoTime around the complete Spring filter chain; warm-up excluded; client round trips retained separately
rateLimits: unchanged defaults, 100 creates per hour per account and 600 redirects per minute per client
topology: native macOS Node driver -> localhost-only Docker TCP pass-through -> loopback Java TLS endpoint; relay upstream is the exact existing trusted source; PostgreSQL/Redis are disposable Docker Desktop containers
tlsPreflight: Verified localhost certificate and guarded bootstrap returned 200 before traffic; no TLS verification bypass.
limitations: Local Docker Desktop topology only; no production latency or availability claim.
